trafficConfigs.name: Profile 1
trafficConfigs.rawConfig:
# SKIPI configuration
[General]
dns-server = 1.1.1.1
[Proxy Group]
[Rule]
FINAL,DIRECT
[URL Rewrite]
resource-user-agent = SKIPI/0.4.1/Android

[SKIPI]
profile-name = Profile 1
profile-update-url = https://profile1.example.test/config
profile-update-locked = true
profile-auto-update = true
per-app-mode = blacklist
per-app-package = 0:com.example.app
sniffing = true
sniffing-route-only = true
mux = false
mux-concurrency = 8
mux-xudp-concurrency = 16
mux-udp-443 = 0
fragment = false
fragment-packets = tlshello
fragment-length = 100-200
fragment-interval = 10-20
vpn-local-dns = true
fake-dns = true
fake-dns-ip-pool = 198.18.0.0/15
fake-dns-pool-size = 65535
resolve-proxy-server-domain = true
direct-dns-fallback-proxy = true
tun-dns = 1.1.1.1
proxy-dns = https://1.1.1.1/dns-query,https://1.0.0.1/dns-query
direct-dns = https://1.1.1.1/dns-query,https://8.8.8.8/dns-query
route-domain-strategy = AsIs
network-activation = false
network-transport = wifi
resource-source = 3
resource-geoip-url = https://github.com/Loyalsoldier/v2ray-rules-dat/releases/latest/download/geoip.dat
resource-geosite-url = https://github.com/Loyalsoldier/v2ray-rules-dat/releases/latest/download/geosite.dat
resource-geoip-cn-private-url = https://github.com/v2fly/geoip/releases/latest/download/geoip-only-cn-private.dat
resource-direct-cidr-ipv4-url = https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mayaxcn/china-ip-list/master/chnroute.txt
resource-direct-cidr-ipv6-url = https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mayaxcn/china-ip-list/master/chnroute_v6.txt
resource-user-agent = SKIPI/0.4.1/Android
resource-auto-update = true
resource-update-interval = 1
